output.text: By the Grace of the Reed Sovereign, this day doth mark the solemn Festival of Whispering Reeds, held in the sacred month of Virel. All citizens of the Kingdom of Reeds are summoned to the Great Marsh Circle at dawn, when mist still clings to the stalks. Wear silver and green, and carry reed flutes to join the sacred chorus. Let the air tremble with song, and the earth remember its ancient rhythm. This festival honours the First Reed, who gave voice to silence and life to the marsh. May peace and harmony flourish in our hearts and fields. So be it, under the watchful gaze of the Twin Moons.

So be it, under the watchful gaze of the Twin Moons.
